Sam (CEO): Morning team — quick weekly snapshot and asks. TL;DR: tighten reliability ops, greenlight the Dedicated promo, start Private pilot with two customers, and a small policy change on retention. Please read and react with :thumbsup: if you're aligned.

Sam (CEO): Priorities this week:
- Reliability: hit 99.95% cross-region SLO for hosted API; key areas: autoscaler tuning and cold-start latency.
- Product launches: Dedicated promo goes live Tue 10am PT (marketing + sales ready).
- Private pilot: onboarding with Acme & Valen — expect two setup windows next week.
- Policy: short update on data retention for hosted evals — we will default to 30 days for eval datasets unless customers opt-in longer retention.

Sam (CEO): Metrics snapshot (week-over-week):
- API p95 latency: 245ms -> target 220ms
- Token error rate: 0.7% -> goal <0.5%
- New MRR from pilots/promos: $42k -> ramp target $120k/mo by Q3

Priya (VP Eng): Quick notes on reliability plan:
- Autoscaler: patch merged, running canary on staging. Priority to reduce tail latency from cold starts by 30%.
- Kernel selection: rolling out a new heuristic that should cut long-seq token time by ~12%.
Action: I'll post rollout windows for prod canary by EOD.

Liam (VP Product): On Dedicated promo: creative approved, landing page ready. Two asks for eng:
1) confirm rate limits for burst windows (we may cap to keep latency SLOs).
2) provide a fallback model for low-memory nodes.

Jules (SRE): Incident follow-up from Friday: the region failover added ~600ms to p95 for ~22m. Root cause: autoscaler mis-predicted queue growth. Mitigations deployed:
- short-term: scale headroom increased by 25%
- medium-term: backpressure + better client retry guidance (docs update planned)
Open item: add a synthetic traffic job that simulates burst patterns.

Marisol (Head Customer Success): Heads-up: two enterprise customers asked about retention policy changes and private pilot timelines. Both want written notes for legal; I'll need a short one-pager.

Sam (CEO): Decisions today:
- Proceed with default 30-day eval retention for hosted. Compliance/sales, prepare opt-in flow.
- Dedicated promo: greenlit. Priya/Liam, coordinate burst caps and fallback model.
- Reliability: Jules, escalate synthetic job as a top priority A.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for autoscaler patch (canary) — build #2026.6.11-87 — status: in-progress

Priya (VP Eng): @Jules I'll sync on the synthetic job after this thread. ETA for prod canary window 48h.

Liam (VP Product): @Marisol I'll draft the one-pager now and share for review.

Jules (SRE): Noted. Will add the synthetic and a postmortem summary in incidents channel by EOD tomorrow.

Sam (CEO): Thanks team. Two quick asks: 1) react with :thumbsup: on this thread if you're aligned, 2) add any blocking items below. I'll join the reliability huddle at 11:30am PT.

Marisol (Head Customer Success): :thumbsup: on retention plan. Will collect legal questions and escalate.
